user.title: Realme Smart Scale
user.description: Choose the Realme scale from the discovered Bluetooth devices. If your scale is not listed, make sure it is awake (step on it once) or add its MAC address manually.

profile.title: First user
profile.description: Optionally pick an existing person from Home Assistant (the name is filled in for you), then confirm the profile the scale uses for the connection handshake and body-composition calculations. More users can be added later from the integration options.

abort.not_supported: This device does not look like a Realme Smart Scale.

error.invalid_mac: Enter the scale's Bluetooth MAC address in the form XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX.

menu.title: Users & measurements
menu.description: {count} user(s) configured - {pending} unassigned measurement(s). Choose what you want to do. Changes are applied when you pick "Save and close".

menu_options.assign_unknown: Assign unassigned measurements to a user
menu_options.reassign_measurement: Reassign a recent measurement to another user

remove_user.title: Remove a user
remove_user.description: Removing a user also deletes their stored measurements.

active_user.title: Active user
active_user.description: The active user's profile is sent to the scale when it connects. Currently: {active}.

settings.title: Auto-assignment
settings.description: A measurement is given to a user when their last reading is within the weight tolerance (kg) and, when both readings carry impedance, within the impedance tolerance (Ohm). A reading matching no one - or matching several people - stays unassigned until you confirm it. 0 disables an axis.

assign_pick.title: Assign measurement
assign_pick.description: {pending} measurement(s) waiting. Pick one and tell it which user it belongs to.

reassign_pick.title: Reassign measurement
reassign_pick.description: The {count} most recent measurements are listed with their current owner. Pick one and choose the user it actually belongs to - its body-composition values are recalculated for that user.

error.last_user: At least one user must remain on this scale.
error.user_missing: That measurement is no longer available (it may already have been assigned).

device_not_found.message: Could not find Realme Smart Scale {address} as a connectable Bluetooth device: {reason}
